mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sign_in_sheet_print_job ( country_code, work_date, warehouse, sheet_locale, page_count, printed_by, printed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{countryCode}, #{workDate}, #{warehouse}, #{sheetLocale}, #{pageCount}, #{printedBy}, #{printedAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT j.id AS id, j.country_code AS countryCode, j.work_date AS workDate, j.warehouse AS warehouse, j.sheet_locale AS sheetLocale, j.page_count AS pageCount, j.printed_by AS printedBy, j.printed_at AS printedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sign_in_sheet_print_row r WHERE r.job_id = j.id) AS personCount FROM sign_in_sheet_print_job j WHERE j.work_date = #{workDate}
ORDER BY j.printed_at DESC, j.id DESC

SELECT r.id AS id, r.job_id AS jobId, j.warehouse AS warehouse, j.printed_at AS printedAt, r.seq_no AS seqNo, r.person_name AS personName, r.agency_name AS agencyName, r.shift_name AS shiftName FROM sign_in_sheet_print_row r INNER JOIN sign_in_sheet_print_job j ON j.id = r.job_id WHERE j.work_date = #{workDate}
ORDER BY j.printed_at DESC, j.id DESC, r.row_index ASC, r.id ASC
